meta.name: add-gmail-tool
meta.description: Add Gmail as an MCP tool (read, search, send, label, draft) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. The agent gets Gmail tools in every enabled group; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time so no raw credentials are ever in the container or on disk in usable form.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 工具读取、搜索、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 中通过 MCP 操作 Gmail 邮箱。
copy.tagline_en: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail emails via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Gmail from an agent via MCP.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会获得一批 Gmail 工具,能搜索、读取、发送、起草、删除邮件,下载附件,并管理标签和过滤器。真实登录令牌由 OneCLI 在请求时注入,不会以明文保存在容器或磁盘。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 Claude 接入 Gmail 工具(例如搜索、发送邮件、管理标签)时触发。

say.text: 列出我的 Gmail 标签
搜索收件箱里上个月的发票邮件
起草一封回复张三的邮件

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gets Gmail tools (search/read/send/draft/delete emails, download attachments, manage labels/filters). OneCLI injects real OAuth tokens at request time; no raw credentials are stored in the container or disk.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Gmail as a tool for Claude, e.g. to search or send emails or manage labels.

say_en.text: Search my inbox for last month's invoices
say_en.note: Calls mcp__gmail__search to find matching emails.

say_en.text: Draft a reply email to Zhang San
say_en.note: Calls mcp__gmail__draft_email to create a draft.
